entry.name: jit.fx.cf.radial
entry.description: Applies radial blur to a given input texture.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output dims to input
attributes.description: Adapt output dims to input (default = 1). When enabled the output dimensions will match the leftmost input dimensions.

attributes.name: amt
attributes.digest: Blur amount
attributes.description: Sets the amount of radial blur to apply (default = 0).

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.digest: Bypass effect processing
attributes.description: Bypass effect processing flag (default = 0). When enabled the input is passed through to the output without processing.

attributes.name: center
attributes.digest: Radial blur center
attributes.description: The normalized texture coordinates of the radial blur center (default = 0.5 0.5).

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: dim
attributes.digest: Output texture dimensions
attributes.description: The output texture dimensions. Whenis enabled this will be set automatically to the leftmost input.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.digest: Context name
attributes.description: The named context (jit.world, jit.pworld or jit.gl.node) to draw this effect (default = none). If none provided a suitable context will be found implicitly.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.digest: Enable processing and output
attributes.description: Enable flag (default = 1). When the flag is set, processing and output is enabled.
